Name: norisu's desaturated craftables
Author: norisunine
Description:
exactly what the title says- i took the craftables and desaturated most of them, mainly the new seasonal plants, garden pots, signs, and most of the old craftables!

INSTALLATION
- locate your stardew valley folder(there are plenty of tutorials online for this)
- once inside, select Content/TileSheets
- drag and drop the Craftables.xnb from this mod into the TileSheets folder, replacing the original
- done!

NOTE: remember to back up your original Craftables.xnb file so you can uninstall this mod if you need to!

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
